message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover for "TEMPO" dated "15-21 SEPTEMBER 2014". The layout features a large, off-white, fluted classical column centered vertically on a light gray background. To the left of the column stands a stout man with his arms crossed, wearing a dark gray suit and dark shoes. He has short hair and a somber expression, facing toward the left edge. To the right, a thin man in a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt and dark trousers leans his back against the column. He has his hands in his pockets and looks toward the right with a tired expression. Both figures are rendered in a caricature style with exaggerated proportions.

The top of the cover displays the text "MAFIA GULA PERBATASAN MALAYSIA", "DANA JANGGAL KAMPANYE FOKE", and "KAS MERAH PERTAMINA" in black. The large red masthead "TEMPO" is positioned below these. Centered on the column is the bold black title "TRANSISI SETENGAH MATI", followed by a smaller paragraph beginning "Kerja Tim Transisi dipersoalkan Yudhoyono." The bottom right corner contains pricing, a website address, and a barcode. A solid red border runs down the left side.
